Ranveer Singh's film 'Operation Dhurandhar' releases in Japan

Actor Ranveer Singh has released a special video message for his Japanese fans. The film, titled 'Operation Dhurandhar', is now showing in Japan. The release is being watched to see if it can match the box office success of the film 'RRR' in the country.
